method: Reviewed the official City Legistar matter record and all ten listed attachments. Downloaded and extracted each noncanonical attachment, compared their legislative role and project-scope content with the existing canonical final enactment, and rendered the image-only enacted record and its incorporated project-scope attachment.

matter.title: Approving the Programming of Funds and Projects for the 2025-2034 Decade Plan for Capital Improvements Including the 2025 Two-Year Capital Budget

attachments.title: R-117 original resolution packet
attachments.reason: The tracked original includes an earlier proposal and supporting material; it predates all committee and floor substitutes.

attachments.title: R-117 approved committee substitute
attachments.reason: Unsigned committee substitute superseded by the final floor substitute and signed enacted resolution.

attachments.title: R-117 committee-substitute Attachment A
attachments.reason: This committee-substitute scope attachment predates the final floor-substitute scopes incorporated in the signed enactment.

attachments.title: R-117 committee-substitute blueline
attachments.reason: Intermediate blueline version superseded by the final floor substitute and signed enactment.

attachments.title: R-117 Committee of the Whole amendments
attachments.reason: The amendment packet documents deliberation, including a withdrawn amendment; final enacted text is retained as the governing record.

attachments.title: R-117 approved floor substitute
attachments.reason: Unsigned floor substitute superseded by the signed R-2025-014 enactment.

attachments.title: R-117 floor-substitute Attachment A
attachments.reason: The final signed enactment incorporates the final 23-page scope attachment; this prior attachment is retained through that canonical final record only.

attachments.title: R-117 Council amendments
attachments.reason: Passed floor amendments are incorporated into the enacted resolution and do not constitute a separate canonical plan record.

attachments.title: R-117 final floor substitute
attachments.reason: Substantive resolution text is represented by the signed enacted R-2025-014, which adds the adoption and approval pages and incorporates final scopes.

result: Retain the existing 31-page signed R-2025-014 once: it comprises the eight-page enacted F/S R-25-117 and its final 23-page Attachment A project scopes. No other attachment is a distinct final City original requiring R2 archival.
